per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system SHALL be fast and secure such that it is not flaky in the field.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall achieve a 98% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2% of the available online time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system SHALL operate on both office workstations (standard corporate browsers) and on tablets used by field staff.
The system SHALL be hooked up so the parts feed from Choice Parts comes through automatically, with fallbacks if the feed hiccups.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall interface with the Choice Parts System. This provides the feed of recycled parts data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Parts availability data from the Choice Parts feed SHALL be real-time or near-real-time; if periodic syncs are used they SHALL be frequent enough that the data is trustworthy.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall interface with the Choice Parts System. This provides the feed of recycled parts data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: A recycled parts search SHALL return results fast enough that adjusters do not lose focus; a parts search SHALL take no more than 15 seconds (upper bound before complaints).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: A repair-facility (shop) search SHALL return results faster than parts searches and ideally feel almost immediate; target under 10 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for the preferred repair facility shall take no longer than 8 seconds. The preferred repair facility is returned within 8 seconds'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system SHALL follow corporate architecture, UI rules, cloud, and security standards to avoid governance issues and ease deployments/approvals.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall adhere to the corporate Architecture guidelines'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system SHALL be dead simple and require minimal training so that users are comfortable after a short onsite session of two days.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to learn by Adjusters and Collision Estimators. The product shall be learned with two days onsite training'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system SHALL provide audit trails tied to estimates showing who changed what and when, including indicators of which parts came from recycled sources and whether the supplier matched the parts feed.
Ratings and comments about shops SHALL be semi-formal, tied to the user's role, saved with the estimate, and protected so not everyone can change everyone else's ratings.

The system SHALL implement role-based access controls so adjusters and estimators can see/edit appropriate data, managers have broader visibility, and administrative or personal data is not exposed to field staff.
The system SHALL have high availability; availability targets shall be in the high nineties percentage.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall achieve a 98% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2% of the available online time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system SHALL include protections against Denial-of-Service attacks (e.g., rate-limiting, CDN, WAF) and SHALL have monitoring and an operational support plan for incident response.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall prevent malicious attacks including denial of service.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system SHALL have monitoring that alerts operations immediately on traffic spikes or service degradation.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall prevent malicious attacks including denial of service.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system SHALL cope with peaks of concurrent users in the low thousands without slowing noticeably.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be able to handle up to 1500 simultaneous users. The system shall perform with 1500 users as a time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system SHALL degrade gracefully on flaky mobile networks; offline-first is not required but it SHALL not force large downloads (e.g., not require ~30MB) just to check a part.
Search functionality SHALL be forgiving and support fuzzy matching for vehicle codes and shop names.
The system SHALL provide reporting that allows managers to see recycled parts utilization across regions and identify trends (e.g., shops avoiding recycled parts).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall interface with the Choice Parts System. This provides the feed of recycled parts data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system SHALL retain audit and estimate-related logs in a manner suitable for regulator and internal audit review (showing who changed what and when).
The system SHALL avoid forcing users back to previous manual processes when slow or down; it SHALL maintain business continuity through reliability and fallbacks.
The system SHALL conform to corporate look-and-feel so the UI matches other tools and is recognizable.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall comply with corporate User Interface Guidelines'
